name: Apprenticeship - Draft POST (no E&M), Approve, PUT adds E&M (DECIMAL), then PUT new E&M aim (2627 AY)
description: Proves the PUT path looks up the E&M value from SLD. POSTs a draft apprenticeship with no English & Maths and approves it. PUT 1 adds an E&M aim with learnAimRef DECIMAL (stub price 1234.56; payload still sends amount 400, which should be ignored). WAIT lets you inspect the DB. PUT 2 replaces it with learnAimRef 60346498 (stub price 1000). Learning matches E&M by LearnAimRef, so PUT 2 removes the DECIMAL row and adds a new one rather than updating the amount in place.

steps.name: SLD Create a Draft Apprenticeship with no English & Maths
SLD PUTs adding an English & Maths aim (learnAimRef DECIMAL)
Capture the DECIMAL E&M amount from Learning
Wait - inspect DB (EnglishAndMaths.Amount should be 1234.56), then continue with the second PUT
SLD PUTs a different English & Maths aim (learnAimRef 60346498, stub price 1000)

assertions.name: After PUT 1, Learning EnglishAndMaths.Amount was the SLD value (1234.56), not the inbound 400
After PUT 2, Learning EnglishAndMaths.Amount for aim 60346498 is the SLD value (1000)
After PUT 2, only one E&M row remains and the DECIMAL aim is removed
